name: ShowSky_10
short_caption: The robot opens both arms wide and lifts them upward with palms up to show something above.
movement_description: The robot starts from its neutral standing posture and smoothly raises both arms outward and upward. Its hands open with the palms facing upward, gesturing toward the sky or a high ceiling. After holding this open, elevated pose for a brief moment, it gently lowers both arms back to its sides, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The arms sweep upward and outward to a medium-large width, requiring clear lateral and upper space around the robot's upper body.
